import java.util.*;
public class Router {public static String route(Map<String,String> routes,String path){return routes.entrySet().stream().filter(e->e.getKey().equals("/")||path.equals(e.getKey())||path.startsWith(e.getKey()+"/")).max(Comparator.comparingInt(e->e.getKey().length())).map(Map.Entry::getValue).orElse(null);}}
